import React, { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { bindValue, trigger, useValue } from "cs2/api";
import { Button as GameButton, Scrollable, Tooltip } from "cs2/ui";
import { NativePanel, EditorButton, RadioOption } from "./native-panel";
import { color, paletteRows } from "./palette";
import { ColorPicker } from "./color-picker";
import "./window.scss";

type State = {
    available?: boolean; visible?: boolean; changed?: boolean; hasTarget?: boolean; hasColors?: boolean; canPaste?: boolean;
    canUndo?: boolean; canApply?: boolean; confirmPaste?: boolean; append?: boolean; readOnly?: boolean;
    target?: string; source?: string; group?: string; status?: string; pairs?: string; channel2?: string;
    targets?: string[]; targetIndex?: number; groupIndex?: number; groupCount?: number; paletteRevision?: number;
    page?: number; pages?: number; total?: number; generated?: number;
    preview?: { number: number; colors: string[] }[];
    previewRows?: string[];
    windowX?: number; windowY?: number;
};
const workspaceWidth = bindValue<number>("editorHierarchy", "width", 500);
const stateBinding = bindValue<string>("mwColors", "state", "{}");
const command = (action: string, extra = {}) => trigger("mwColors", "command", JSON.stringify({ action, ...extra }));
function Button({ className = "", ...props }: React.ComponentProps<typeof GameButton>) {
    return <EditorButton {...props} className={"mw-button " + className} />;
}
export function Swatch({ value, channel, showHex = true }: { value: string; channel: number; showHex?: boolean }) {
    const fill = color(value);
    return <div className="mw-color" title={fill ? value : "Invalid hex color"}>
        <span className="mw-channel">{`Channel ${channel}`}</span>
        <span className="mw-swatch" style={{ backgroundColor: fill || "transparent" }}>{!fill && "!"}</span>
        {showHex && <span className="mw-value">{value}</span>}
    </div>;
}
function LoadedColors({ text, channel, onChange }: { text: string; channel: number; onChange: (text: string) => void }) {
    const rows = paletteRows(text);
    const [editing, setEditing] = useState<number | null>(null);
    const [anchor, setAnchor] = useState({ left: 0, right: 0, top: 0, bottom: 0 });
    const content = rows.length === 0 ? <p>No colors loaded.</p> : rows.map((row, i) => {
        const column = channel === 2 ? 0 : channel;
        const value = row[column] || "Missing value";
        return <div key={i}>
            <div className="mw-loaded-row"><span className="mw-number">{i + 1}</span>
                <button type="button" className="mw-edit-swatch" aria-label={"Edit channel " + channel + " color " + (i + 1)} aria-expanded={editing === i}
                    title="Click to adjust color" onClick={e => {
                        const rect = e.currentTarget.getBoundingClientRect();
                        setAnchor({ left: rect.left, right: rect.right, top: rect.top, bottom: rect.bottom });
                        setEditing(editing === i ? null : i);
                    }}><Swatch channel={channel} value={value} /></button>
            </div>
            {editing === i && <ColorPicker anchor={anchor} value={value} label={"Channel " + channel + " · Color " + (i + 1)} onClose={() => setEditing(null)} onChange={next => {
                const updated = rows.map(r => [...r]); updated[i][column] = next;
                onChange(updated.map(r => r.join(" ")).join("\n"));
            }} />}
            {row.length !== (channel === 2 ? 1 : 2) && <span className="mw-warning">Expected {channel === 2 ? "one color" : "two paired colors"} per line.</span>}
        </div>;
    });
    return <Scrollable vertical className="mw-loaded mw-loaded-scroll" trackVisibility="scrollable"><div>{content}</div></Scrollable>;
}
function ColorSection({ title, children, initiallyExpanded = true }: React.PropsWithChildren<{ title: string; initiallyExpanded?: boolean }>) {
    const [expanded, setExpanded] = useState(initiallyExpanded);
    return <section className={"mw-color-section" + (expanded ? " mw-section-expanded" : "")}>
        <button type="button" className="mw-section-toggle" aria-expanded={expanded} onClick={() => setExpanded(!expanded)}>
            <span className={"mw-collapse-arrow" + (expanded ? " mw-expanded" : "")} aria-hidden="true" />{title}
        </button>
        {expanded && <div className="mw-section-details">{children}</div>}
    </section>;
}
function InfoLines({ text, className = "" }: { text?: string; className?: string }) {
    return <div className={"mw-info " + className}>{(text || "").replace(/([.!?])\s+(?=[A-Z])/g, "$1\n").split("\n").filter(Boolean).map((line, i) => <p key={i}>{line}</p>)}</div>;
}
// Keep placement independent of DOM layout during the editor loading transition.
export function ColorLauncher() {
    const s: State = JSON.parse(useValue(stateBinding) || "{}");
    const width = useValue(workspaceWidth);
    if (!s.available) return null;
    return <div className="mw-colors-launcher" style={{ left: `${width + 84}rem` }}>
        <GameButton className="mw-colors-launcher-button"
        focusKey="mwColors.launcher" aria-label="MW Color Variations" title="MW Color Variations" selected={!!s.visible}
        onSelect={() => command(s.visible ? "close" : "open")}>
        <img className="mw-colors-launcher-icon" src="data:image/png;base64," alt="" />
    </GameButton></div>;
}
export function ColorWindow() {
    const raw = useValue(stateBinding);
    const s: State = JSON.parse(raw || "{}");
    const [pairs, setPairs] = useState("");
    const [channel2, setChannel2] = useState("");
    const [append, setAppend] = useState(false);
    useEffect(() => { setPairs(s.pairs || ""); setChannel2(s.channel2 || ""); setAppend(!!s.append); },
        [s.pairs, s.channel2, s.append, s.target, s.paletteRevision]);
    if (!s.visible) return null;
    const dirty = pairs !== (s.pairs || "") || channel2 !== (s.channel2 || "") || append !== !!s.append;
    const blocked = !!s.changed;
    const preview = s.hasColors && (s.generated || 0) > 0 ? (
        <section className="mw-combination-summary">
            <p>{`${s.generated} combinations generated from the selected colors.`}</p>
            <p>{`${s.total} total variations after applying.`}</p>
            {dirty && <p className="mw-warning">Colors changed. Generate combinations again before applying.</p>}
        </section>
    ) : null;
    const footer = <div className="mw-footer">
        {preview}
        <div className="mw-actions mw-footer-actions">
            <Button className="mw-apply" variant="primary" disabled={!s.canApply || dirty} onSelect={() => command("apply")}>Apply combinations</Button>
            <Button className="mw-undo" disabled={!s.canUndo} onSelect={() => command("undo")}>Undo last edit</Button>
        </div>
    </div>;
    return <NativePanel initialPosition={{ x: s.windowX ?? .30, y: s.windowY ?? .12 }} onPositionChange={position => command("position", position)} className="mw-native-window" contentClassName="mw-native-content"
        header="MW Color Variations" footer={footer} onClose={() => command("close")}>
        <div className="mw-window-layout">
        <div className="mw-toolbar"><Button onSelect={() => command("capture")}>Use current selection</Button>
            {blocked && <InfoLines className="mw-warning" text="Selection changed. Capture it to switch targets." />}</div>
        <div className="mw-body mw-fixed-controls">
            <div className="mw-body-inner">
            <h3>Target mesh</h3>
            {s.hasTarget && <p className="mw-target-name">{s.target || s.targets?.[s.targetIndex || 0]}</p>}
            {(s.targets || []).length > 1 && <label className="mw-target-choice">Choose mesh <select aria-label="Choose target mesh" value={s.targetIndex || 0} onChange={e => command("target", { index: Number(e.currentTarget.value) })}>{s.targets!.map((t,i) => <option key={i} value={i}>{t}</option>)}</select></label>}
            {!s.hasTarget && <p>Select a render mesh in Object Info, then use current selection.</p>}
            {s.hasTarget && <>
                <h3>Copy Color Properties</h3>
                <p>{s.source ? "Copied from: " + s.source : "Copy the full color setup for use on another asset."}</p>
                <div className="mw-actions mw-copy-actions"><Button disabled={blocked || !s.hasColors} onSelect={() => command("copy")}>Copy</Button>
                    <Button disabled={blocked || !s.canPaste} onSelect={() => command("paste")}>Paste</Button></div>
                {!s.hasColors && <p>Paste will add Color Properties to this mesh.</p>}
                {s.confirmPaste && <div className="mw-confirm"><p>{s.target}: {s.hasColors ? "replace ALL Color Properties settings?" : "add Color Properties and paste?"}</p>
                    <div className="mw-actions"><Button variant="primary" disabled={blocked} onSelect={() => command("confirm")}>Confirm paste</Button>
                        <Button onSelect={() => command("cancel")}>Cancel</Button></div></div>}
            </>}
            {s.hasColors && <>
                <h3>Variation group</h3><p>{s.group}</p>
                {(s.groupCount || 0) > 1 && <div className="mw-actions">
                    <Button disabled={blocked} onSelect={() => command("group", { index: ((s.groupIndex || 0) + s.groupCount! - 1) % s.groupCount! })}>Previous group</Button>
                    <Button disabled={blocked} onSelect={() => command("group", { index: ((s.groupIndex || 0) + 1) % s.groupCount! })}>Next group</Button></div>}
                <Tooltip tooltip="Reloads colors from the selected asset's current variation group into the channel lists. Replaces unsaved color edits and clears generated combinations. Does not change the asset.">
                    <div><Button className="mw-wide" disabled={blocked} onSelect={() => command("load")}>Reload colors from asset</Button></div>
                </Tooltip>
                <InfoLines text="Channels 0 and 1 stay paired by row. Channel 2 combines with every pair. Click a swatch to adjust its color." />
                <div className="mw-channel-sections">{[0, 1, 2].map(channel => <ColorSection key={channel} title={"Channel " + channel}>
                    <LoadedColors channel={channel} text={channel === 2 ? channel2 : pairs} onChange={channel === 2 ? setChannel2 : setPairs} />
                </ColorSection>)}</div>
                <Button variant="primary" className="mw-wide mw-preview-button" disabled={blocked} onSelect={() => command("preview", { pairs, channel2, append })}>Generate combinations</Button>
                <div className="mw-group-mode" role="radiogroup" aria-label="Group mode">
                    <span className="mw-group-mode-label">Group mode</span>
                    <div className="mw-group-mode-options">
                        <RadioOption label="Replace group" checked={!append} onSelect={() => setAppend(false)} />
                        <RadioOption label="Append to group" checked={append} onSelect={() => setAppend(true)} />
                    </div>
                </div>
                <InfoLines className="mw-status" text={s.status} />
                {dirty && <InfoLines className="mw-status" text="Palette changed. Generate combinations before applying." />}
                {s.readOnly && <InfoLines className="mw-status" text="This asset is read-only. Make an editable copy to apply changes." />}
            </>}
            {!s.hasColors && <InfoLines className="mw-status" text={s.status} />}
            </div>
        </div>
        </div>
    </NativePanel>;
}
